verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own deployment tracking: a Deployments API, real-time deployment tracking to spot new errors or regressions, and version data captured and filterable on errors. Native GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab repo integrations are also listed. However, nothing shows an issue displaying the release it first appeared in, or any suspect-commit attribution. Missing for 10: documented first-seen release per issue, suspect-commit identification linking errors to specific commits, detail on how deployments map to commits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can associate errors with releases and commits so each issue shows the release it first appeared in and the suspect commit that likely caused it

citations.quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
Connect to your repo through native integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab
use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags
You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API
